# Transactions a Bitcoin Knots regtest node mined, written by prefork_reachability_e2e.py.
# The same node, run without the fork scheduled, refuses optedInFunder for its signature
# ("Signature opts in to the hardfork, which is not active here", not missing-inputs) and reports
# missing-inputs for legacySpendOfIt, which is the property under test here.
#
# malleatedFunder is legacyFunder carrying the witness of optedInFunder. A txid does not commit to a
# witness, so it has legacyFunder's txid while appearing to opt in, which is what a hostile PSBT would
# supply to forge the label. Built by the test that refuses it.
